name: Minami-sanchi no Niku Dorei Nee-sama
original_name: みなみさん家の肉奴隷姉様
source:
This is a digital novel / CG image collection about Haruka from Minami-ke.

Also features 2 younger sisters and other characters.

Ordinary daily life is disrupted suddenly by a dirty homeless.
Being introduced to the unknown pleasure, Haruka's daily life begins to collapse.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE052344.html]DLsite English[/url]]
